scanNote: Skanda oldingi o'quvchining qo'lyozma javoblari bor. 1-mashqda 12 tadan 11 tasi to'g'ri, lekin 2 va 3-mashqlarda TIZIMLI xato bor: u egalik apostrofini ('s) unutgan va ko'plik egasi bo'lgan joyda 'their' o'rniga 'his/her' yozgan. Bu xatolar 'Ko'p uchraydigan xato' bo'limida saqlangan — ular juda foydali dars beradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the family tree. Choose words from the list to complete the sentences 1 to 12.
exercises.instructionUz: Oila daraxtiga qarang. Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab, 1–12 gaplarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
OILA DARAXTI:

            Susan  ═  Paul        (bobo va buvi)
                │
        ┌───────┴────────┐
     Liz ═ Tim       Sarah ═ Simon
        │                │
     George          Mary   John

  Susan va Paul — Tim va Sarahning ota-onasi
  Tim — Lizning eri, Georgening otasi
  Sarah — Simonning xotini, Mary va Johnning onasi
  Tim va Sarah — aka-singil
  George, Mary, John — amakivachchalar

RO'YXAT (19 so'z):
  grandparents, parents, son, daughter, cousin, aunt, uncle,
  brother, sister, nephew, niece, wife, husband, granddaughter,
  grandson, children, grandfather, grandmother, grandchildren

MUHIM: qarindoshlik KIM NUQTAI NAZARIDAN aytilganiga bog'liq.
Masalan Sarah — Tim uchun 'sister', George uchun 'aunt',
Susan uchun 'daughter'. Bitta odam, uch xil nom!

commonMistake.whatUz: Skandagi oldingi o'quvchi 3-bandda 'Mary is Liz and Tim's NEPHEW' deb yozgan.
commonMistake.whyUz: XATO — Mary QIZ. Qiz jiyan 'niece', o'g'il jiyan esa 'nephew'. To'g'ri javob: NIECE. Bu farq o'zbek tilida yo'q ('jiyan' ikkalasiga ham) — shuning uchun ingliz tilida diqqat qilish kerak.

items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Simon — Georgening ammasi Sarahning eri → uncle.
Ular Georgening otasi Timning ota-onasi → bobo va buvi.
Meri — Timning singlisi Sarahning QIZI → niece (qiz jiyan). 'nephew' — o'g'il jiyan.
Ikkalasi ham Susan va Polning farzandlari → aka-singil.
Georgening otasi Tim — Meri va Jonning onasi Sarahning akasi → amakivachcha.

items.textEn: 6  Susan and Paul are Tim and Sarah's ____ .
items.uz: Susan va Pol Tim va Saraga kim?
items.whyUz: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri ota-ona.
Meri — ularning qizi.
George — ularning o'g'li.
Sara — Georgening otasi Timning singlisi → amma.
Ikkalasi ham Sara va Simonning farzandlari → aka-singil.
Meri — ularning nabirasi (QIZ) → granddaughter. O'g'il bo'lsa 'grandson'.
Ular er-xotin → husband.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the family tree and fill in the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Oila daraxtiga qarang va tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAR BIR BANDDA IKKI BO'SHLIQ:

  1-bo'shliq — EGALIK SHAKLI (ism + 's)
  2-bo'shliq — EGALIK SIFATI (his, her, their)

NAMUNA:
  Liz is TIM'S wife. She is HIS wife.

EGALIK SIFATINI TANLASH — nechta egasi borligiga qarang:
  bitta erkak → his
  bitta ayol  → her
  IKKI yoki undan ko'p → THEIR

BU YERDA ENG KO'P XATO QILINADI:
  'Susan and Paul are George, Mary and John's grandparents.'
  → uchta nabira → THEIR grandparents (his EMAS!)

commonMistake.whatUz: Skandagi oldingi o'quvchi apostrofni ('s) unutgan ('John', 'Simon', 'Liz', 'Tim' deb yozgan) va ko'plik egasi bo'lgan joyda 'their' o'rniga 'his/her' yozgan.
commonMistake.whyUz:
IKKI TIZIMLI XATO:
1) Egalikni ko'rsatish uchun 's SHART: 'John's grandparents' (Johnning bobo-buvisi), 'John grandparents' EMAS.
2) Egasi BIR NECHTA bo'lsa — THEIR. 'George, Mary and John' — uch kishi, demak 'their grandparents'.
Bu xatolar o'zbek tilidan ta'sir: o'zbekchada 'ularning' bittagina so'z va qo'shimchani unutish oson.

lines.textEn: Liz is Tim's wife. She is his wife.
lines.uz: Liz — Timning xotini. U uning xotini.

lines.textEn: Tim is ____ husband. He is ____ husband.
lines.whyUz: Egalik shakli: Liz + 's. Egalik sifati: Liz — ayol → her.

lines.textEn: Susan and Paul are George, Mary and ____ grandparents. They are ____ grandparents.
lines.hintUz: UCHTA nabira bor: George, Mary, John
lines.whyUz: Uch egasi → 's faqat OXIRGISIGA (John's). Uch kishi → THEIR (his EMAS!).

lines.textEn: Mary and John are Sarah and ____ children. They are ____ children.
lines.whyUz: Ikki egasi → 's oxirgisiga (Simon's). Ikki kishi → THEIR.

lines.textEn: Sarah is ____ aunt and Simon is his uncle.
lines.whyUz: 'Simon is HIS uncle' — 'his' = George. Demak Sarah ham George'ning ammasi → George's aunt.

lines.textEn: Mary is Tim and ____ niece. She is ____ niece.
lines.whyUz: Ikki egasi → Liz's. Ikki kishi → THEIR.

lines.textEn: John is Liz and ____ nephew. He is ____ nephew.
lines.whyUz: Ikki egasi → Tim's. Ikki kishi → THEIR.

lines.textEn: George is Tim's son. He is ____ son.
Susan is Mary's grandmother. She's ____ grandmother.
John is ____ cousin. He is his cousin.
lines.whyUz: 'He is HIS cousin' — 'his' = George. Demak John George'ning amakivachchasi.

lines.textEn: John is ____ brother and Mary is ____ sister.
lines.whyUz: Jon — Merining akasi, Meri esa Jonning singlisi. Ikkalasi ham 's bilan.

lines.textEn: Mary is Sarah and ____ daughter. She is ____ daughter.
lines.whyUz: Ikki egasi → Simon's. Ikki kishi → THEIR.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the family tree and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Oila daraxtiga qarang va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL QOLIPI:
  Whose + qarindoshlik + is/are + ISM?

JAVOB QOLIPI:
  He's/She's/They're + EGALIK SHAKLI + qarindoshlik.

NAMUNA:
  Whose father is Simon? — He's Mary and John's father.

DIQQAT — savolni TESKARI o'qish kerak:
  'Whose father is Simon?' = 'Simon KIMNING otasi?'
  Ya'ni Simon OTA, biz uning FARZANDLARINI topamiz.

Bu chalkash — shuning uchun oila daraxtida yo'nalishni
yaxshi tekshiring.

commonMistake.whatUz: Skandagi oldingi o'quvchi 3-savolga 'She's Mary's daughter' deb javob bergan.
commonMistake.whyUz: XATO — yo'nalish teskari olingan. 'Whose daughter is Sarah?' = 'Sara KIMNING qizi?'. Sara — Susan va Polning qizi. Meri esa SARANING qizi — bu boshqa munosabat. To'g'ri javob: 'She's Susan and Paul's daughter.'

items.question: Whose father is Simon?
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Simon — Meri va Jonning otasi.

items.question: Whose mother is Liz?
items.whyUz: Liz — Georgening onasi (Liz va Timning o'g'li).

items.question: Whose daughter is Sarah?
items.whyUz: Sara — Susan va Polning qizi. Oila daraxtida u ularning tagida turibdi.

items.question: Whose cousins are Mary and John?
items.whyUz: Ko'plik → 'Whose cousins ARE ...?' va 'They're'. Ular Georgening amakivachchalari.

items.question: Whose brother is Tim?
items.whyUz: Tim — Saraning akasi (ikkalasi Susan va Polning farzandlari).

exercises.explanationUz:
XARAKTER SIFATLARI — ta'rifdan sifatni toping.

Har bir bandda odamning XULQI tasvirlangan.
O'sha xulqqa mos sifatni tanlang.

BU BETDAGI SIFATLAR:
  aggressive — tajovuzkor, jahldor
  bossy      — buyruqboz
  rude       — qo'pol
  clever     — aqlli
  kind       — mehribon
  friendly   — do'stona
  polite     — muloyim
  gorgeous   — maftunkor (KO'RINISH, xarakter emas!)
  pretty     — chiroyli (KO'RINISH)
  good-looking — kelishgan (KO'RINISH)

DIQQAT: chalg'ituvchi variantlar ko'pincha KO'RINISH sifatlari —
savolda esa XARAKTER so'ralgan bo'ladi.

items.textEn: 1  He gets angry easily. He is ____ .
items.whyUz: 'get angry' = jahli chiqmoq. Tez jahli chiqadigan odam — aggressive (tajovuzkor). 'kind' (mehribon) va 'clever' (aqlli) mos emas.

items.textEn: 2  He always tells people what to do. He is ____ .
items.whyUz: 'tell people what to do' = buyruq bermoq → bossy. 'gorgeous' — ko'rinish sifati, mos emas.

items.textEn: 3  He isn't polite. He is very ____ .
items.whyUz: 'polite' (muloyim) ning aksi — 'rude' (qo'pol).

items.textEn: 4  She learns easily because she's very ____ .
items.whyUz: Oson o'rganish — AQL belgisi → clever. 'pretty' va 'good-looking' — ko'rinish sifatlari.

groups.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida bu juftliklar FARQ qiladi. O'zbekchada esa bitta so'z — shuning uchun eng ko'p xato shu yerda.
Ba'zi qarindoshlik so'zlari faqat guruh uchun ishlatiladi.
Juftlik bilan yodlash — eng samarali usul.
Testlarda chalg'ituvchi variant ko'pincha boshqa guruhdan olinadi.

items.base: kind, clever, rude, bossy, aggressive, friendly, polite

patterns.exampleEn: Simon is George's uncle. Sarah is Tim's sister.
patterns.exampleUz: Simon — Georgening amakisi. Sara — Timning singlisi.

patterns.formula: X is + ISM and ISM's + qarindoshlik.
patterns.exampleEn: Mary is Sarah and Simon's daughter.

patterns.formula: X is + ISM's + qarindoshlik. He/She is + his/her/their + qarindoshlik.
patterns.exampleEn: Liz is Tim's wife. She is his wife.
patterns.exampleUz: Liz — Timning xotini. U uning xotini.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ikkinchi gapda ism o'rniga EGALIK SIFATI keladi.
Egasi bir nechta bo'lsa — THEIR.

patterns.formula: Whose + qarindoshlik + is/are + ISM? — He's/She's/They're + ISM's + qarindoshlik.
patterns.exampleEn: Whose father is Simon? — He's Mary and John's father.
patterns.exampleUz: Simon kimning otasi? — U Meri va Jonning otasi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Savolda yo'nalishga diqqat: 'Whose father is Simon?' —
Simon OTA, biz uning farzandlarini topamiz.

patterns.exampleEn: He gets angry easily. He is aggressive.
patterns.exampleUz: U tez jahli chiqadi. U tajovuzkor.
patterns.explanationUz: Avval xulq tasvirlanadi, keyin unga mos sifat aytiladi.

patterns.formula: She + fe'l + BECAUSE she's very + sifat.
patterns.exampleEn: She learns easily because she's very clever.
patterns.exampleUz: U oson o'rganadi, chunki juda aqlli.
patterns.explanationUz: 'because' bilan sabab aytiladi — insho va gapirishda muhim.
